Subject: Request: pilot onboarding without PO for NovaPower

Hi Aisha,

Hope you're well — quick ask from our side. We're kicking off a 6-week integration pilot with Redwood (proof-of-concept for grid-edge telemetry ingestion). The engagement is small — estimate ~$6k over the pilot — and our procurement team prefers to invoice after delivery.

Because this is a short, time-sensitive pilot, can Redwood make a temporary exception to the standard PO-required onboarding and allow an invoice-only path for 90 days? We can provide the documents you require now (W-9, COI, bank remit) and a short SOW. If helpful, I can also sign an acknowledgement of Redwood's standard terms for the pilot period.

Attached: SOW excerpt (for scope).

If you need anything specific to speed internal approvals, tell me and I'll get it over.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Business Ops | NovaPower Energy
elena.morales@novapower.com

Subject: Re: Request: pilot onboarding without PO for NovaPower

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the context.

Short answer: we can consider a temporary invoice-only onboarding for a limited pilot, but we need a few items and internal approvals before we can enable billing without a PO. To keep this moving, please provide the following evidence:

- Completed vendor intake form (link): https://docs.redwood.com/vendor-intake/form-RDW-INTAKE-2027
- Signed W-9 (US entities)
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (or policy confirmation)
- Bank remit instructions (voided check or bank details PDF)
- Short SOW or invoice template showing line items and total
- Company registration or VAT/Tax ID (if applicable)

Operational guardrails we typically require for temporary no-PO:
- 90-day invoice-only period with a hard spend cap (suggested cap: $15,000 for this pilot)
- One-time approval from Finance (Marcus) and Legal (Laura) — they will check risk and tax implications
- Payment terms default to Net30 unless Finance approves otherwise

If you can upload the items above and confirm the pilot spend estimate, I will route for approvals. Marissa — I know you own the commercial relationship; can you confirm the expected pilot ARR motion and whether this deal is on a path to an SOW + PO after the pilot?

Elena — once you send the docs I'll push this to Marcus and Laura with a recommended approval path.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com
